long_description:
Kick off the weekend with Susanna Barkataki. 

Yoga is much more than poses.

At its roots, yoga is a structured, living ethical system, a practical, radical, and deeply compassionate framework for how to be in the world. And when we actually live it, our lives completely change.

This immersive morning session goes deep into the heart of yogic philosophy: Susanna will share stories from her life, the Yamas and Niyamas, Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, and the full Eightfold Path as a path to embody, practice and breathe into your actual life.

Through practice, reflection, discussion, and direct transmission, we explore:

Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha the five outer ethical codes and how they guide us in relationship, teaching, and community

Saucha, Santosha, Tapas, Svadhyaya, Ishvara Pranidhana the five inner codes for soulful, engaged living

The Yoga Sutras of Patanjali including the Locks and Keys of Sutra 1.33, and how "Yogas Chitta Vritti Nirodhah" is not an idea but an experience

How yogic ethics are a framework for justice, equity, and liberation not just personal transformation

How to bring these teachings authentically into your cuing, your sequencing, and your studio culture

Expect to move, reflect, discuss, and go home with practices you can use immediately in your teaching, your relationships, and your daily life.

CEUs available. 

Early bird pricing available until 10/31/26.
